newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $3.466 bln week of Sept 30.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $3.466 bln week of Sept 30.

text.p: Scheduled competitive and negotiated municipal bond sales are expected to total $3.466 billion in 95 offerings for the week of Sept 30, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Competitive sales total $1.598 billion in 50 offerings. The largest issue is a $168 million District of Columbia issue on October 3.

Negotiated sales total $1.868 billion in 45 offerings. The largest issue is a $270 million Denver City & County Airport revenue bond offering through Lehman Brothers. -----------------------------------------------------------
